title: Pocket Shulker
description: Light weight plugin to open Shulkers from your hand without placing them and it's only 5kb
body:
_If you're using 1.0 or 1.0.1 please update to 1.0.2 that fixed some MORE item dupes_

**Light weight plugin to open Shulkers from your hand without placing them**

And it's only 5kb

- Prevents Shulkerception
- Protection against deaths/teleports/disconnects
- Should survive server crashes without dupes..

_Discord: ronon_omega if it's broken in some debilitating way, flick me a message_

_Thanks **Herrmörlin** for the bug reports_
